notes: Focused IEEE 1516.2-2025 §6.2.17 public-API witness for the Reference Data Type Name rule at p. 94 l. 86. A valid-name control FOM is first accepted through public Create; the schema-valid negative FOM differs only by a period in its user-defined reference data type name and must be rejected as InconsistentFOM. This demonstrates the period restriction only, not every HLA naming rule, all reference-data-type fields, arbitrary FOMs, or conformance.
